name: AnyPS5
description_en: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
readme_excerpt: About Tool for automatic executables porting to Linux and Windows. Includes a relinker that converts executable to the target system's native format and implementations of system prx libraries suitable for dynamic linking. No emulation or separate runtime process.
